//: claim-verify-guard: WRITE-TIME claim-vs-record enforcement (VLOOP Item 1, CCRT half). Registers on PreToolUse for the write-path tools, so a durable payload carrying a ```vloop-claims``` block is recomputed against its named sources BEFORE the write lands. Hook = claim-verify-guard.sh: BLOCKS (exit 2) on any claim/record mismatch, on a malformed claim block, and on a vacuous 0-claim block against a substantial payload; PASSES (exit 0) when no claim block is present or every claim verifies; FAIL-OPEN-BUT-LOGGED on an internal error (a gate must not block on its own bug). stdout stays empty by contract — the reason rides on stderr. Honors the CRT master switch: both 'off' and 'observe' silence it, since it is an intervention hook. Keep the command string byte-identical across any future touch (merge dedups by command).
